meta.checks_note: U <= K: (d) = (b) is an identity of the Gram model (checks Q^T Q = I only; keys *_k0_gram_identity_rel). U > K: (d) - (b) is the effect of the pruned kappa = 0 design (and, with --load_rule rank, of the unequal split), not a check; the shared-content (overlap) gain is (d) -> (c): diag[].decomp_rel.c_over_d. nmse_se: Monte Carlo SE over the gain draws; scheme differences: minus_load_joint / minus_load_pu (paired)

slope_gains.note: G0 / over_per_user (= pred_c_over_b / pred_c_over_a) are the low-SNR slope gains; the *_formula_kappa1 values equal them only if coef1_is_first_common_mode; G0_formula_kappa_bar is a summary number, not a slope gain
